text:
Devon Lee: Hey team — Sales intake from FinSecure (enterprise banking). They want hosted + dedicated + private availability for an open model variant used in PoC: "finsecure/koala-lite-7b-q4f16". Requirements: EU + APAC regions, FIPS/KMS integration, support for 4-bit quantized weights (Q4F16) with same tokenizer, and version pinning (stable v2.1 deployment for 12 months).

Asha Patel: Quick clarifying Qs — do they need latency SLA? Is this contractual or exploratory?

Devon Lee: It's contractual. MOU signed; migrating to enterprise next quarter. SLA: 200ms p50 for simple text gen; 99.9% uptime for Dedicated. They also requested an offline private bundle for air-gapped deploys.

Lucy Nguyen: Onboarding checklist: we need model tarball, model card, license file, tokenizer vocab/hash to verify compatibility. Any public repo link or private artifact location?

Devon Lee: They shared a pointer: s3://finsecure-models/koala-lite-v2.1.tar.gz. They claim Apache-2.0 license but asked us to confirm.

Kevin Zhao: Infra note — our runtime supports Q4F16 for Llama-like families but we must run compatibility tests: KV cache correctness, attention kernel stability up to sequence length 4096, and torchscript/compile artifact checks. Request a small test bundle with golden outputs.

Devon Lee: I'll request a minimal harness and golden outputs from FinSecure.

Samir Banerjee: Legal will verify the Apache-2.0 claim. If there are model-specific restrictions or non-commercial clauses we cannot host on Hosted. Please attach the license to the intake ticket.

catalog-bot: New intake created: https://redwood.atlassian.com/RI-2219. Checklist: model_card.md, license.txt, tokenizer.json, manifest.json, golden_prompts.json.

Lucy Nguyen: Also need quantization metadata: which tool produced Q4F16 (bitsandbytes, custom tooling, etc.). If custom, we may need to convert or repro. Request quant script or quant stats from them.

Asha Patel: Prioritization: high-value (enterprise + private bundle + SLA). Proposed scope: Hosted (EU) + Dedicated (reserved EU capacity) + Private bundle (air-gap). Launch criteria: Legal clearance, onboarding runbook and private bundle validated in staging, SLA validated with load test (p50 <= 200ms on Dedicated at target QPS), KV cache & consistency tests pass.

Kevin Zhao: I'll allocate engineering cycles for compatibility tests but need confirmation on sequence length distribution and typical prompt sizes. Also need access to their harness and anonymized workload traces.

Devon Lee: FinSecure will share anonymized traces and harness by EOD Wednesday.

Lucy Nguyen: If license checks out, estimated onboarding effort: 3 days to catalog + 2 days for quant compatibility + 3 days for private bundle packaging/testing = ~8 eng-days. Add 2 days for legal & infra signoff.

Asha Patel: Assigning P0 and creating product backlog item. Assigning Lucy as onboarding lead, Kevin for infra, Samir for legal.

Asha Patel: Intake description to paste into RI-2219:
``
Customer: FinSecure
Model: finsecure/koala-lite-7b-q4f16
Requested regions: EU, APAC
Deployment modes: Hosted, Dedicated, Private bundle
SLA: 99.9% uptime, p50 latency 200ms
Artifacts: model tarball, tokenizer, license, golden_prompts, quant_meta
Priority: High (enterprise contract)
Deliverables: onboarding runbook, dedicated capacity config, private bundle
``

Devon Lee: Done — FinSecure accepted RI-2219 and requested go-live target 2026-06-01.

Lucy Nguyen: I'll pick up RI-2219 and start the catalog checklist after Samir confirms license. I'll report blockers in this thread.

Samir Banerjee: Legal review started. Ping me if you find anything other than Apache-2.0 or dual-licensing notes.

Kevin Zhao: Note for APAC: verify local GPU availability for Dedicated to meet latency. If not possible, propose geo-fallback to EU with documented latency tradeoffs — requires product sign-off.

Asha Patel: OK — we'll treat APAC as soft for initial launch and document fallback policy in the runbook.

Devon Lee: FinSecure is fine with EU-first as long as APAC is on the roadmap.

Asha Patel: Next steps: Devon to obtain harness + golden outputs; Samir to finish license check; Lucy/Kevin to run compatibility tests after artifacts arrive. Updating RI-2219 with assignees and timeline.

catalog-bot: RI-2219 updated: assignees [Lucy Nguyen, Kevin Zhao, Samir Banerjee], target: 2026-06-01.

Lucy Nguyen: Noted. I'll post the first compatibility smoke report here once tests run.

Devon Lee: Thanks all :thumbsup:
